title: Activity settings
notes: Controls come first; longer explanations move into disclosures.
Save, deletion and unavailable actions have distinct treatments.
Optional details stay close to the controls without filling the page.

title: Passwords
notes: Password actions use the same grouped rows and buttons as other settings.
Passkey details and import instructions stay available in disclosures.

title: Translation settings
notes: The category name now describes its purpose.
A clear save button replaces the text-only action.
Setup and privacy details are kept together below the controls.

title: Narrow settings
notes: A category picker keeps every destination available without a large header grid.
The selected settings start much closer to the top.

title: Assistant footer
notes: Reasoning and speed move into one Model options control.
Source status stays visible beside the page chip.

title: New-tab errors
notes: The error card fits its content instead of filling the remaining window.
Error and recovery action stay together.

title: Translation window
notes: Larger labels and grouped language controls match the app’s visual rhythm.
Detailed sharing information is available without crowding the main actions.

title: Setup on a narrow screen
notes: The illustration stays visible at a smaller size on narrow screens.
Failure wording is shorter and uses the shared error treatment.
